Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Mg and Zn centers each a tetrahedral environment of four F neighbors, while F centers show three- or four-coordinate environments. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Mg tetrahedra and between Mg and Zn tetrahedra, and edge-sharing between Zn tetrahedra.
